description: Add client-side validation to a form so users get useful feedback before invalid data is submitted.
requirements: Repository should contain a form with at least three input fields
Form should validate required fields and at least one format rule such as email, URL or password length
Validation errors should be displayed near the related fields
Submit action should be blocked when the form is invalid
Repository should include screenshots, a demo link or clear steps to verify the validation behavior
title: Add Form Validation
